build_erniemtp_model: build an ErnieMTP inference-only model with vLLM config and optional prefix for multi-token prediction
create_mtp_layer: create an ErnieMultiTokenPredictorLayer with vLLM config and prefix for a single MTP transformer block
create_mtp_predictor: create an ErnieMultiTokenPredictor with vLLM config and prefix for multi-token prediction layers and embeddings
run_mtp_forward: run the ErnieMTP forward pass with input ids, positions, hidden states, and spec step index for token prediction
load_mtp_weights: load weights into ErnieMTP with stacked parameter mapping and spec layer name rewriting for checkpoint restoration
